contexts: eight-week daytime groups of ten to twelve
reading: Completion depends on whether the programme fits people's lives (session times, travel, language) and on what happens in the first two or three sessions, when most people leave. The three planned adaptations each target one barrier: the evening group targets work, the hybrid option targets travel, and the orientation call targets expectations before the first session. Nothing was retrieved, so the evidence nodes are unchecked leads; the clinic's own data are the main source, and they miss everyone who leaves.
